title: The Secrets of Learning a New Language

cues.text: I love learning foreign languages.
cues.en: I love learning foreign languages.
cues.zh: 我熱愛學習外語。

cues.text: In fact, I love it so much that I like to learn a new language every two years,
cues.en: In fact, I love it so much that I like to learn a new language every two years,
cues.zh: 其實我愛到每兩年就學一種新語言，

cues.text: currently working on my eighth one.
cues.en: currently working on my eighth one.
cues.zh: 目前我在學第八種語言。

cues.text: When people find that out about me, they always ask me,
cues.en: When people find that out about me, they always ask me,
cues.zh: 如果有人發現這件事， 他們都會問我，

cues.text: "How do you do that? What's your secret?"
cues.en: "How do you do that? What's your secret?"
cues.zh: 「你是怎麼辦到的？秘訣是什麼？」

cues.text: And to be honest, for many years, my answer would be,
cues.en: And to be honest, for many years, my answer would be,
cues.zh: 老實說，多年來我的答案大多是：

cues.text: "I don't know. I simply love learning languages."
cues.en: "I don't know. I simply love learning languages."
cues.zh: 「不知道耶！我就是愛學語言。」

cues.text: But people were never happy with that answer.
cues.en: But people were never happy with that answer.
cues.zh: 但大家對這個答案都不滿意。

cues.text: They wanted to know why they are spending years trying to learn even one language,
cues.en: They wanted to know why they are spending years trying to learn even one language,
cues.zh: 他們想知道，為何自己費時多年， 而且只學一種語言，

cues.text: never achieving fluency,
cues.en: never achieving fluency,
cues.zh: 還是無法說得流利，

cues.text: and here I come, learning one language after another.
cues.en: and here I come, learning one language after another.
cues.zh: 而我卻能一個語言接著一個語言學。

cues.text: They wanted to know the secret of polyglots,
cues.en: They wanted to know the secret of polyglots,
cues.zh: 他們想知道語言達人的秘訣，

cues.text: people who speak a lot of languages.
cues.en: people who speak a lot of languages.
cues.zh: 精通多種語言者的秘訣。

cues.text: And that made me wonder, too,
cues.en: And that made me wonder, too,
cues.zh: 這也勾起了我的好奇心，

cues.text: how do actually other polyglots do it?
cues.en: how do actually other polyglots do it?
cues.zh: 其他語言達人是怎麼辦到的？

cues.text: What do we have in common?
cues.en: What do we have in common?
cues.zh: 我們有什麼共通點？

cues.text: And what is it that enables us
cues.en: And what is it that enables us
cues.zh: 是什麼因素讓我們

cues.text: to learn languages so much faster than other people?
cues.en: to learn languages so much faster than other people?
cues.zh: 比其他人學語言的速度還快得多？

cues.text: I decided to meet other people like me and find that out.
cues.en: I decided to meet other people like me and find that out.
cues.zh: 我決定和其他像我這樣的人 見面來找出答案。

cues.text: The best place to meet a lot of polyglots
cues.en: The best place to meet a lot of polyglots
cues.zh: 要碰到很多語言達人的最佳地點

cues.text: is an event where hundreds of language lovers
cues.en: is an event where hundreds of language lovers
cues.zh: 就在幾百位語言愛好者參加的聚會，

cues.text: meet in one place to practice their languages.
cues.en: meet in one place to practice their languages.
cues.zh: 大家在同一個地方 練習自己在學的語言。

cues.text: There are several such polyglot events organized all around the world,
cues.en: There are several such polyglot events organized all around the world,
cues.zh: 世界各地都有一些這種 辦給語言達人參加的活動，

cues.text: and so I decided to go there
cues.en: and so I decided to go there
cues.zh: 所以我決定去那

cues.text: and ask polyglots about the methods that they use.
cues.en: and ask polyglots about the methods that they use.
cues.zh: 問問語言達人他們用了什麼方法。

cues.text: And so I met Benny from Ireland,
cues.en: And so I met Benny from Ireland,
cues.zh: 我碰到從愛爾蘭來的白尼，

cues.text: who told me that his method is to start speaking from day one.
cues.en: who told me that his method is to start speaking from day one.
cues.zh: 他告訴我，他的方法是 從第一天就開始說。

cues.text: He learns a few phrases from a travel phrasebook
cues.en: He learns a few phrases from a travel phrasebook
cues.zh: 他先從旅遊書籍學幾個詞，

cues.text: and goes to meet native speakers
cues.en: and goes to meet native speakers
cues.zh: 然後去和當地人碰面，

cues.text: and starts having conversations with them right away.
cues.en: and starts having conversations with them right away.
cues.zh: 馬上和他們對話。

cues.text: He doesn't mind making even 200 mistakes a day,
cues.en: He doesn't mind making even 200 mistakes a day,
cues.zh: 他不介意每天犯多達兩百個錯誤，

cues.text: because that's how he learns, based on the feedback.
cues.en: because that's how he learns, based on the feedback.
cues.zh: 因為他就是這樣 從別人給的回饋學習。

cues.text: And the best thing is, he doesn't even need to travel a lot today,
cues.en: And the best thing is, he doesn't even need to travel a lot today,
cues.zh: 最棒的是，現在 他根本不用到處旅行，

cues.text: because you can easily have conversations with native speakers
cues.en: because you can easily have conversations with native speakers
cues.zh: 因為你可以輕易和當地人 在你舒適的客廳交談，

cues.text: from the comfort of your living room, using websites.
cues.en: from the comfort of your living room, using websites.
cues.zh: 只要有網路就行。

cues.text: I also met Lucas from Brazil
cues.en: I also met Lucas from Brazil
cues.zh: 我也碰到巴西來的盧卡斯，

cues.text: who had a really interesting method to learn Russian.
cues.en: who had a really interesting method to learn Russian.
cues.zh: 他學俄語的方法超有趣。

cues.text: He simply added a hundred random Russian speakers on Skype as friends,
cues.en: He simply added a hundred random Russian speakers on Skype as friends,
cues.zh: 他在 Skype 上任意 加一百個說俄語的人好友，

cues.text: and then he opened a chat window with one of them
cues.en: and then he opened a chat window with one of them
cues.zh: 然後開啟其中一個人的對話視窗，

cues.text: and wrote "Hi" in Russian.
cues.en: and wrote "Hi" in Russian.
cues.zh: 用俄語寫「嗨」。

cues.text: And the person replied, "Hi, how are you?"
cues.en: And the person replied, "Hi, how are you?"
cues.zh: 這個人回：「嗨，你好嗎？」

cues.text: Lucas copied this and put it into a text window with another person,
cues.en: Lucas copied this and put it into a text window with another person,
cues.zh: 盧卡斯把這句話覆製貼到 另一個人的對話視窗，

cues.text: and the person replied, "I'm fine, thank you, and how are you?"
cues.en: and the person replied, "I'm fine, thank you, and how are you?"
cues.zh: 這個人回： 「我很好，謝謝，你呢？」

cues.text: Lucas copied this back to the first person,
cues.en: Lucas copied this back to the first person,
cues.zh: 他再把這句話覆製，貼給第一個人，

cues.text: and in this way, he had two strangers have a conversation with each other
cues.en: and in this way, he had two strangers have a conversation with each other
cues.zh: 透過這個方法， 他讓兩個陌生人交談，

cues.text: without knowing about it.
cues.en: without knowing about it.
cues.zh: 而且他們自己根本不知道。

cues.text: (Laughter)
cues.en: (Laughter)
cues.zh: （笑聲）

cues.text: And soon he would start typing himself,
cues.en: And soon he would start typing himself,
cues.zh: 不久後他就可以開始自己打字，

cues.text: because he had so many of these conversations
cues.en: because he had so many of these conversations
cues.zh: 因為有過這麼多對話之後，

cues.text: that he figured out how the Russian conversation usually starts.
cues.en: that he figured out how the Russian conversation usually starts.
cues.zh: 他就知道要怎麼開始用俄語交談。

cues.text: What an ingenious method, right?
cues.en: What an ingenious method, right?
cues.zh: 很天才的方法，對吧？

cues.text: And then I met polyglots who always start by imitating sounds of the language,
cues.en: And then I met polyglots who always start by imitating sounds of the language,
cues.zh: 後來我碰到一個語言達人， 他都會從模仿一個語言的聲音開始；

cues.text: and others who always learn the 500 most frequent words of the language,
cues.en: and others who always learn the 500 most frequent words of the language,
cues.zh: 有一部分的人會先學 最常用的五百個單字；

cues.text: and yet others who always start by reading about the grammar.
cues.en: and yet others who always start by reading about the grammar.
cues.zh: 還有一些人會先學文法。

cues.text: If I asked a hundred different polyglots,
cues.en: If I asked a hundred different polyglots,
cues.zh: 如果我問一百個語言達人，

cues.text: I heard a hundred different approaches to learning languages.
cues.en: I heard a hundred different approaches to learning languages.
cues.zh: 會聽到一百種不同的語言學習法。

cues.text: Everybody seems to have a unique way they learn a language,
cues.en: Everybody seems to have a unique way they learn a language,
cues.zh: 每個人都有自己 獨特的方式學習語言，

cues.text: and yet we all come to the same result of speaking several languages fluently.
cues.en: and yet we all come to the same result of speaking several languages fluently.
cues.zh: 最後大家都能流利說多種語言。

cues.text: And as I was listening to these polyglots telling me about their methods,
cues.en: And as I was listening to these polyglots telling me about their methods,
cues.zh: 聽著其他達人說他們的方法時，

cues.text: it suddenly dawned on me:
cues.en: it suddenly dawned on me:
cues.zh: 我突然明白：

cues.text: the one thing we all have in common
cues.en: the one thing we all have in common
cues.zh: 我們的共通點

cues.text: is that we simply found ways to enjoy the language-learning process.
cues.en: is that we simply found ways to enjoy the language-learning process.
cues.zh: 是都會去找出 享受學習語言的方法。

cues.text: All of these polyglots were talking about language learning
cues.en: All of these polyglots were talking about language learning
cues.zh: 所有達人在談語言學習的時候

cues.text: as if it was great fun.
cues.en: as if it was great fun.
cues.zh: 都像是學語言超有趣。

cues.text: You should have seen their faces
cues.en: You should have seen their faces
cues.zh: 可惜你們沒看到他們

cues.text: when they were showing me their colorful grammar charts
cues.en: when they were showing me their colorful grammar charts
cues.zh: 給我看他們做的彩色文法表、

cues.text: and their carefully handmade flash cards,
cues.en: and their carefully handmade flash cards,
cues.zh: 精心自製的單字卡、

cues.text: and their statistics about learning vocabulary using apps,
cues.en: and their statistics about learning vocabulary using apps,
cues.zh: 在應用程式上學單字的統計，

cues.text: or even how they love to cook based on recipes in a foreign language.
cues.en: or even how they love to cook based on recipes in a foreign language.
cues.zh: 以及他們熱愛用外語食譜作菜 這些時刻的神情。

cues.text: All of them use different methods,
cues.en: All of them use different methods,
cues.zh: 每個人都採用不同方法，

cues.text: but they always make sure it's something that they personally enjoy.
cues.en: but they always make sure it's something that they personally enjoy.
cues.zh: 但他們都先確定這些事能帶來樂趣。

cues.text: I realized that this is actually how I learn languages myself.
cues.en: I realized that this is actually how I learn languages myself.
cues.zh: 我理解到其實這也是 我自己學語言的方法。

cues.text: When I was learning Spanish, I was bored with the text in the textbook.
cues.en: When I was learning Spanish, I was bored with the text in the textbook.
cues.zh: 我學西班牙語的時候， 覺得課本上的文章很無聊。

cues.text: I mean, who wants to read about Jose
cues.en: I mean, who wants to read about Jose
cues.zh: 我的意思是，誰會想讀

cues.text: asking about the directions to the train station. Right?
cues.en: asking about the directions to the train station. Right?
cues.zh: 何西問去火車站要怎麼走？

cues.text: I wanted to read "Harry Potter" instead,
cues.en: I wanted to read "Harry Potter" instead,
cues.zh: 我反而想先讀《哈利波特》，

cues.text: because that was my favorite book as a child,
cues.en: because that was my favorite book as a child,
cues.zh: 因為那是我小時候最愛的書，

cues.text: and I have read it many times.
cues.en: and I have read it many times.
cues.zh: 我看過很多次了。

cues.text: So I got the Spanish translation of "Harry Potter" and started reading,
cues.en: So I got the Spanish translation of "Harry Potter" and started reading,
cues.zh: 所以我找到這本書的西班牙語譯本，

cues.text: and sure enough, I didn't understand almost anything at the beginning,
cues.en: and sure enough, I didn't understand almost anything at the beginning,
cues.zh: 當然一開始我幾乎完全看不懂，

cues.text: but I kept on reading because I loved the book,
cues.en: but I kept on reading because I loved the book,
cues.zh: 但我還是繼續讀， 因為我超愛這本書，

cues.text: and by the end of the book, I was able to follow it almost without any problems.
cues.en: and by the end of the book, I was able to follow it almost without any problems.
cues.zh: 到最後我已經能毫無障礙讀下去了。

cues.text: And the same thing happened when I was learning German.
cues.en: And the same thing happened when I was learning German.
cues.zh: 我學德語也是同樣的情況。

cues.text: I decided to watch "Friends," my favorite sitcom, in German,
cues.en: I decided to watch "Friends," my favorite sitcom, in German,
cues.zh: 我決定用德語看《六人行》， 這是我最愛的喜劇，

cues.text: and again, at the beginning it was all just gibberish.
cues.en: and again, at the beginning it was all just gibberish.
cues.zh: 同樣地，一開始全都是 我聽不懂的話，

cues.text: I didn't know where one word finished and another one started,
cues.en: I didn't know where one word finished and another one started,
cues.zh: 我根本分不清這些聲音 是一個字的頭還是尾，

cues.text: but I kept on watching every day because it's "Friends."
cues.en: but I kept on watching every day because it's "Friends."
cues.zh: 但我每天繼續看， 因為那是《六人行》。

cues.text: I can watch it in any language. I love it so much.
cues.en: I can watch it in any language. I love it so much.
cues.zh: 我可以每個語言都看， 我真的超愛這個影集。

cues.text: And after the second or third season,
cues.en: And after the second or third season,
cues.zh: 看了兩三季之後，

cues.text: seriously, the dialogue started to make sense.
cues.en: seriously, the dialogue started to make sense.
cues.zh: 真的，我開始聽得懂一些對話了。

cues.text: I only realized this after meeting other polyglots.
cues.en: I only realized this after meeting other polyglots.
cues.zh: 我在和其他語言達人碰面之後 才瞭解這一點。

cues.text: We are no geniuses
cues.en: We are no geniuses
cues.zh: 我們都不是天才，

cues.text: and we have no shortcut to learning languages.
cues.en: and we have no shortcut to learning languages.
cues.zh: 沒有學語言的捷徑。

cues.text: We simply found ways how to enjoy the process,
cues.en: We simply found ways how to enjoy the process,
cues.zh: 我們只是找到享受過程的方法，

cues.text: how to turn language learning from a boring school subject
cues.en: how to turn language learning from a boring school subject
cues.zh: 找到將學語言這個在學校無聊的科目

cues.text: into a pleasant activity which you don't mind doing every day.
cues.en: into a pleasant activity which you don't mind doing every day.
cues.zh: 變成愉快的活動， 不介意每天都要做。

cues.text: If you don't like writing words down on paper,
cues.en: If you don't like writing words down on paper,
cues.zh: 要是你不喜歡手寫單字，

cues.text: you can always type them in an app.
cues.en: you can always type them in an app.
cues.zh: 你可以在應用程式裡打字。

cues.text: If you don't like listening to boring textbook material,
cues.en: If you don't like listening to boring textbook material,
cues.zh: 要是你不愛聽無聊的課文，

cues.text: find interesting content on YouTube or in podcasts for any language.
cues.en: find interesting content on YouTube or in podcasts for any language.
cues.zh: 你可以上 YouTube 或播客 找到各種語言的有趣內容。

cues.text: If you're a more introverted person
cues.en: If you're a more introverted person
cues.zh: 要是你比較內向，

cues.text: and you can't imagine speaking to native speakers right away,
cues.en: and you can't imagine speaking to native speakers right away,
cues.zh: 你無法想像馬上和母語人士對話，

cues.text: you can apply the method of self-talk.
cues.en: you can apply the method of self-talk.
cues.zh: 你可以試著自言自語。

cues.text: You can talk to yourself in the comfort of your room,
cues.en: You can talk to yourself in the comfort of your room,
cues.zh: 你可以在房裡舒舒服服 和自己說話，

cues.text: describing your plans for the weekend, how your day has been,
cues.en: describing your plans for the weekend, how your day has been,
cues.zh: 談談你週末的計畫、 今天過得怎麼樣，

cues.text: or even take a random picture from your phone
cues.en: or even take a random picture from your phone
cues.zh: 或是從手機裡找出一張照片，

cues.text: and describe the picture to your imaginary friend.
cues.en: and describe the picture to your imaginary friend.
cues.zh: 跟你的虛擬好友形容這張照片。

cues.text: This is how polyglots learn languages,
cues.en: This is how polyglots learn languages,
cues.zh: 這是語言達人學語言的方式，

cues.text: and the best news is, it's available to anyone
cues.en: and the best news is, it's available to anyone
cues.zh: 最棒的是每個人都可以做，

cues.text: who is willing to take the learning into their own hands.
cues.en: who is willing to take the learning into their own hands.
cues.zh: 尤其是那些想要自學的人。

cues.text: So meeting other polyglots helped me realize
cues.en: So meeting other polyglots helped me realize
cues.zh: 和這麼多達人見面讓我理解到，

cues.text: that it is really crucial to find enjoyment
cues.en: that it is really crucial to find enjoyment
cues.zh: 在學習語言的過程中找到樂趣

cues.text: in the process of learning languages,
cues.en: in the process of learning languages,
cues.zh: 真的很關鍵，

cues.text: but also that joy in itself is not enough.
cues.en: but also that joy in itself is not enough.
cues.zh: 但只有喜悅還不夠。

cues.text: If you want to achieve fluency in a foreign language,
cues.en: If you want to achieve fluency in a foreign language,
cues.zh: 如果你想達到外語流利的程度，

cues.text: you'll also need to apply three more principles.
cues.en: you'll also need to apply three more principles.
cues.zh: 你得依循三個原則。

cues.text: First of all, you'll need effective methods.
cues.en: First of all, you'll need effective methods.
cues.zh: 第一，要採用有效率的方法。

cues.text: If you try to memorize a list of words for a test tomorrow,
cues.en: If you try to memorize a list of words for a test tomorrow,
cues.zh: 為了明天考試背的一長串單字，

cues.text: the words will be stored in your short-term memory
cues.en: the words will be stored in your short-term memory
cues.zh: 這些字會儲存在短期記憶裡，

cues.text: and you'll forget them after a few days.
cues.en: and you'll forget them after a few days.
cues.zh: 過幾天你就會忘了。

cues.text: If you, however, want to keep words long term,
cues.en: If you, however, want to keep words long term,
cues.zh: 如果你想要長時間記得這些單字，

cues.text: you need to revise them in the course of a few days repeatedly
cues.en: you need to revise them in the course of a few days repeatedly
cues.zh: 就必須每隔幾天複習一下，

cues.text: using the so-called space repetition.
cues.en: using the so-called space repetition.
cues.zh: 這是採用所謂的間隔重覆法。

cues.text: You can use apps which are based on this system such as Anki or Memrise,
cues.en: You can use apps which are based on this system such as Anki or Memrise,
cues.zh: 你可以用運用這種系統的應用程式， 像是 Anki 或憶術家，

cues.text: or you can write lists of word in a notebook using the Goldlist method,
cues.en: or you can write lists of word in a notebook using the Goldlist method,
cues.zh: 或是在筆記本寫下單字， 採用所謂的黃金字表法（Goldlist），

cues.text: which is also very popular with many polyglots.
cues.en: which is also very popular with many polyglots.
cues.zh: 這個方法在語言達人間也很受歡迎。

cues.text: If you're not sure which methods are effective and what is available out there,
cues.en: If you're not sure which methods are effective and what is available out there,
cues.zh: 如果你不確定哪些方法有效， 或是有哪些方法可以用，

cues.text: just check out polyglots' YouTube channels and websites
cues.en: just check out polyglots' YouTube channels and websites
cues.zh: 可以上語言達人的 YouTube 頻道和網站，

cues.text: and get inspiration from them.
cues.en: and get inspiration from them.
cues.zh: 從中找尋靈感。

cues.text: If it works for them, it will most probably work for you too.
cues.en: If it works for them, it will most probably work for you too.
cues.zh: 如果對他們有效， 對你來說也八成有效。

cues.text: The third principle to follow
cues.en: The third principle to follow
cues.zh: 第三個要依循的原則

cues.text: is to create a system in your learning.
cues.en: is to create a system in your learning.
cues.zh: 是去找到你學習的系統。

cues.text: We're all very busy and no one really has time to learn a language today.
cues.en: We're all very busy and no one really has time to learn a language today.
cues.zh: 我們都很忙，沒人有空學語言。

cues.text: But we can create that time if we just plan a bit ahead.
cues.en: But we can create that time if we just plan a bit ahead.
cues.zh: 但我們可以創造一點時間， 只要我們提早計畫就行。

cues.text: Can you wake up 15 minutes earlier than you normally do?
cues.en: Can you wake up 15 minutes earlier than you normally do?
cues.zh: 你可以比平常早 15 分鐘起床嗎？

cues.text: That would be the perfect time to revise some vocabulary.
cues.en: That would be the perfect time to revise some vocabulary.
cues.zh: 那是複習單字最好的時間。

cues.text: Can you listen to a podcast on your way to work while driving?
cues.en: Can you listen to a podcast on your way to work while driving?
cues.zh: 你可以在開車上班途中聽播客嗎？

cues.text: Well, that would be great to get some listening experience.
cues.en: Well, that would be great to get some listening experience.
cues.zh: 那也是練聽力的絕佳時間。

cues.text: There are so many things we can do without even planning that extra time,
cues.en: There are so many things we can do without even planning that extra time,
cues.zh: 我們不需要事先 規畫時間就能做很多事，

cues.text: such as listening to podcasts on our way to work
cues.en: such as listening to podcasts on our way to work
cues.zh: 像是上班通勤的時候聽播客，

cues.text: or doing our household chores.
cues.en: or doing our household chores.
cues.zh: 或是做家事的時候也可以。

cues.text: The important thing is to create a plan in the learning.
cues.en: The important thing is to create a plan in the learning.
cues.zh: 重要的是去訂學習的計畫。

cues.text: "I will practice speaking every Tuesday and Thursday
cues.en: "I will practice speaking every Tuesday and Thursday
cues.zh: 「我會每個星期二和四練口說，

cues.text: with a friend for 20 minutes.
cues.en: with a friend for 20 minutes.
cues.zh: 和一個朋友聊二十分鐘。

cues.text: I will listen to a YouTube video while having breakfast."
cues.en: I will listen to a YouTube video while having breakfast."
cues.zh: 我會邊聽 YouTube 影片， 邊吃早餐。」

cues.text: If you create a system in your learning,
cues.en: If you create a system in your learning,
cues.zh: 如果你有了一套學習系統，

cues.text: you don't need to find that extra time,
cues.en: you don't need to find that extra time,
cues.zh: 你就不需要額外找時間，

cues.text: because it will become a part of your everyday life.
cues.en: because it will become a part of your everyday life.
cues.zh: 因為那會成為你生活的一部分。

cues.text: And finally, if you want to learn a language fluently,
cues.en: And finally, if you want to learn a language fluently,
cues.zh: 最後，如果你想把語言練得流利，

cues.text: you need also a bit of patience.
cues.en: you need also a bit of patience.
cues.zh: 你需要一點耐心。

cues.text: It's not possible to learn a language within two months,
cues.en: It's not possible to learn a language within two months,
cues.zh: 兩個月就學會新語言是不可能的事，

cues.text: but it's definitely possible to make a visible improvement in two months,
cues.en: but it's definitely possible to make a visible improvement in two months,
cues.zh: 但是兩個月內看到進步絕對有可能，

cues.text: if you learn in small chunks every day in a way that you enjoy.
cues.en: if you learn in small chunks every day in a way that you enjoy.
cues.zh: 只要你每天用喜歡的方式學一點。

cues.text: And there is nothing that motivates us more
cues.en: And there is nothing that motivates us more
cues.zh: 沒有什麼動機比自己的成功 更能激勵我們。

cues.text: than our own success.
cues.en: than our own success.
cues.zh: 我清楚記得

cues.text: I vividly remember the moment
cues.en: I vividly remember the moment
cues.zh: 我清楚記得

cues.text: when I understood the first joke in German when watching "Friends."
cues.en: when I understood the first joke in German when watching "Friends."
cues.zh: 聽懂德文版《六人行》 第一個笑話的那個時刻。

cues.text: I was so happy and motivated
cues.en: I was so happy and motivated
cues.zh: 我超高興且大受鼓舞，

cues.text: that I just kept on watching that day two more episodes,
cues.en: that I just kept on watching that day two more episodes,
cues.zh: 當天又多看了兩集，

cues.text: and as I kept watching,
cues.en: and as I kept watching,
cues.zh: 我在看的時候，

cues.text: I had more and more of those moments of understanding, these little victories,
cues.en: I had more and more of those moments of understanding, these little victories,
cues.zh: 又得到更多那種理解的時刻， 這些小小的勝利，

cues.text: and step by step, I got to a level where I could use the language
cues.en: and step by step, I got to a level where I could use the language
cues.zh: 一步步地，我到達的程度

cues.text: freely and fluently to express anything.
cues.en: freely and fluently to express anything.
cues.zh: 讓我可以自在流利地 用這個語言表達任何事情。

cues.text: This is a wonderful feeling.
cues.en: This is a wonderful feeling.
cues.zh: 這是很棒的感覺。

cues.text: I can't get enough of that feeling,
cues.en: I can't get enough of that feeling,
cues.zh: 這種感覺我永遠都不嫌少，

cues.text: and that's why I learn a language every two years.
cues.en: and that's why I learn a language every two years.
cues.zh: 因此我每兩年就學一種新語言。

cues.text: So this is the whole polyglot secret.
cues.en: So this is the whole polyglot secret.
cues.zh: 這就是語言達人的秘訣。

cues.text: Find effective methods which you can use systematically
cues.en: Find effective methods which you can use systematically
cues.zh: 找出有效的方法，讓你能夠有系統

cues.text: over the period of some time in a way which you enjoy,
cues.en: over the period of some time in a way which you enjoy,
cues.zh: 且愉快地進行一段時間，

cues.text: and this is how polyglots learn languages within months, not years.
cues.en: and this is how polyglots learn languages within months, not years.
cues.zh: 這就是語言達人只要幾個月而非幾年 就能學會語言的方法。

cues.text: Now, some of you may be thinking,
cues.en: Now, some of you may be thinking,
cues.zh: 現在，在座有些人可能會想，

cues.text: "That's all very nice to enjoy language learning,
cues.en: "That's all very nice to enjoy language learning,
cues.zh: 「享受學語言很好，

cues.text: but isn't the real secret that you polyglots
cues.en: but isn't the real secret that you polyglots
cues.zh: 但真正的秘密是你們語言達人

cues.text: are just super talented and most of us aren't?"
cues.en: are just super talented and most of us aren't?"
cues.zh: 就真的很有天分，而我們沒天分吧？」

cues.text: Well, there's one thing I haven't told you about Benny and Lucas.
cues.en: Well, there's one thing I haven't told you about Benny and Lucas.
cues.zh: 嗯，我還有件事沒和你們說， 和白尼與盧卡斯有關。

cues.text: Benny had 11 years of Irish Gaelic and five years of German at school.
cues.en: Benny had 11 years of Irish Gaelic and five years of German at school.
cues.zh: 白尼在學校學了 11 年 愛爾蘭蓋爾語和五年德語。

cues.text: He couldn't speak them at all when graduating.
cues.en: He couldn't speak them at all when graduating.
cues.zh: 他畢業的時候還沒辦法 用這兩個語言說話。

cues.text: Up to the age of 21, he thought he didn't have the language gene
cues.en: Up to the age of 21, he thought he didn't have the language gene
cues.zh: 他 21 歲的時候，覺得自己 應該沒有語言基因，

cues.text: and he could not speak another language.
cues.en: and he could not speak another language.
cues.zh: 無法說外語。

cues.text: Then he started to look for his way of learning languages,
cues.en: Then he started to look for his way of learning languages,
cues.zh: 後來他開始去找自己的語言學習法，

cues.text: which was speaking to native speakers and getting feedback from them,
cues.en: which was speaking to native speakers and getting feedback from them,
cues.zh: 也就是和母語人士交談， 並從他們身上得到回饋，

cues.text: and today Benny can easily have a conversation in 10 languages.
cues.en: and today Benny can easily have a conversation in 10 languages.
cues.zh: 現在白尼可以輕鬆 用十種語言和人聊天。

cues.text: Lucas tried to learn English at school for 10 years.
cues.en: Lucas tried to learn English at school for 10 years.
cues.zh: 盧卡斯在學校學了十年英語。

cues.text: He was one of the worst students in class.
cues.en: He was one of the worst students in class.
cues.zh: 他是班上掉車尾的學生。

cues.text: His friends even made fun of him
cues.en: His friends even made fun of him
cues.zh: 他朋友還會作弄他，

cues.text: and gave him a Russian textbook as a joke
cues.en: and gave him a Russian textbook as a joke
cues.zh: 送他一本俄語課本來開他玩笑，

cues.text: because they thought he would never learn that language, or any language.
cues.en: because they thought he would never learn that language, or any language.
cues.zh: 因為他們覺得他不可能 學俄語或是其他語言。

cues.text: And then Lucas started to experiment with methods,
cues.en: And then Lucas started to experiment with methods,
cues.zh: 後來盧卡斯開始嘗試新方法，

cues.text: looking for his own way to learn,
cues.en: looking for his own way to learn,
cues.zh: 尋找自己學習的方式，

cues.text: for example, by having Skype chat conversations with strangers.
cues.en: for example, by having Skype chat conversations with strangers.
cues.zh: 像是用 Skype 和陌生人聊天。

cues.text: And after just 10 years,
cues.en: And after just 10 years,
cues.zh: 只花了十年，

cues.text: Lucas is able to speak 11 languages fluently.
cues.en: Lucas is able to speak 11 languages fluently.
cues.zh: 盧卡斯已經可以 流利說 11 種語言了。

cues.text: Does that sound like a miracle?
cues.en: Does that sound like a miracle?
cues.zh: 聽起來像奇蹟嗎？

cues.text: Well, I see such miracles every single day.
cues.en: Well, I see such miracles every single day.
cues.zh: 我每天都看到這樣的奇蹟。

cues.text: As a language mentor,
cues.en: As a language mentor,
cues.zh: 身為語言訓練師，

cues.text: I help people learn languages by themselves,
cues.en: I help people learn languages by themselves,
cues.zh: 我幫大家自學語言，

cues.text: and I see this every day.
cues.en: and I see this every day.
cues.zh: 我每天都會見證這個奇蹟。

cues.text: People struggle with language learning for five, 10, even 20 years,
cues.en: People struggle with language learning for five, 10, even 20 years,
cues.zh: 有人努力學了五年、 十年、二十年語言，

cues.text: and then they suddenly take their learning into their own hands,
cues.en: and then they suddenly take their learning into their own hands,
cues.zh: 突然開始自學，

cues.text: start using materials which they enjoy, more effective methods,
cues.en: start using materials which they enjoy, more effective methods,
cues.zh: 用自己能享受其中的資源， 更有效的方法，

cues.text: or they start tracking their learning
cues.en: or they start tracking their learning
cues.zh: 或是開始記錄自己的學習，

cues.text: so that they can appreciate their own progress,
cues.en: so that they can appreciate their own progress,
cues.zh: 這樣就能看到自己的成長，

cues.text: and that's when suddenly
cues.en: and that's when suddenly
cues.zh: 也就是在這樣的時刻，

cues.text: they magically find the language talent that they were missing all their lives.
cues.en: they magically find the language talent that they were missing all their lives.
cues.zh: 他們神奇地找到 在生命中遺失的語言天分。

cues.text: So if you've also tried to learn a language
cues.en: So if you've also tried to learn a language
cues.zh: 如果你試過學一種語言，

cues.text: and you gave up, thinking it's too difficult
cues.en: and you gave up, thinking it's too difficult
cues.zh: 然後你放棄了，覺得太難，

cues.text: or you don't have the language talent,
cues.en: or you don't have the language talent,
cues.zh: 或是自己沒語言天分，

cues.text: give it another try.
cues.en: give it another try.
cues.zh: 再試一下。

cues.text: Maybe you're also just one enjoyable method away
cues.en: Maybe you're also just one enjoyable method away
cues.zh: 也許你只需要一個有趣的方法

cues.text: from learning that language fluently.
cues.en: from learning that language fluently.
cues.zh: 讓你能學會並流利運用那個語言。

cues.text: Maybe you're just one method away from becoming a polyglot.
cues.en: Maybe you're just one method away from becoming a polyglot.
cues.zh: 也許你只要一個方法， 就能成為語言達人。
